response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware optimization, and deep-learning workload analysis, which are core to the role. While they demonstrate strong software engineering skills and have worked on performance-critical systems (e.g., low-latency apps, real-time metadata handling), their background is heavily focused on web/mobile development, embedded systems, and general software architecture. There is no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD experience.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with experience in performance-critical systems and low-latency applications
Proven ability to work across multiple programming languages and paradigms (JavaScript, TypeScript, D, C++, Java)
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware-software co-design
Lacks direct experience with AI accelerators, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization
Educational background (Bachelor's in CS + Fine Arts) does not meet the required qualifications for the role (PhD/Master's preferred with deep technical experience)

key_factors.factor: AI accelerator and deep-learning workload optimization
